mainEntity.name: What kind of foundation is required for a metal workshop?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most metal workshops require a reinforced concrete slab designed to support concentrated point loads from machinery, workbenches, and vehicles. The slab typically ranges from 4 to 6 inches thick, reinforced with rebar or welded wire mesh, and poured over a compacted aggregate base. If you plan to install heavy-duty machinery or a two-post automotive lift, the foundation will need deeper, thickened footings engineered directly under the lift mounting points to meet structural anchoring specifications.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most metal workshops require an engineered concrete slab with reinforcement; heavy tools or automotive lifts require deeper, thickened concrete footings beneath them.
